entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Kenney City Kit Commercial)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney building-j (the plan named building-a, a squat 3-storey block with few windows; building-j is the kit's 4-storey block with a regular 5-bay window grid, four stacked balconies and a central entrance, the closest to a Japanese mid-rise mansion). FBX member plus its colormap texture, flattened to 20 colours. Height: 4 storeys at ~3 m plus the roof parapet = 12.8 m; it is then 15.75 m wide and 10.13 m deep. Front (entrance, balconies) faces +Z. Static, no clips. Indigo script: lit windows (practical/iris) on pale walls, sky-blue trim and frames, near-black balconies and roof deck.
